# netskope_device_classification_rule (Resource)

DeviceClassificationRule Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_device_classification_rule" "my_deviceclassificationrule" {
  conditions = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
  label      = "...my_label..."
  name       = "...my_name..."
  os         = "mac"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (String) Nested boolean condition tree. Must follow the structure: $and > $and > ($and|$or) > check_node. Parsed as JSON.
- `label` (String) Label (tag) name this rule belongs to
- `name` (String) Rule name (must be unique within its label)
- `os` (String) Operating system this rule applies to. must be one of ["windows", "mac", "android", "ios", "chromeos", "linux"]

### Read-Only

- `rule_id` (Number) Rule ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_device_classification_rule.my_netskope_device_classification_rule
  id = 0
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_device_classification_rule.my_netskope_device_classification_rule 0
```
